node.statement: Uniform norm bound: if T is any t-projection in the extended t-C*-algebra and t<=1/4, the C*-lower bound and product-norm axiom give (1-t)||T||^2 <= ||T^2|| <= ||T||+t, hence ||T||<=2. By the block-diagonal operator-space axiom, ||I_n tensor T||=||T|| for every n. Thus R,P,Q and their amplifications have norm at most 2, and every factor occurring in the fixed telescopes is uniformly bounded after the O(t) perturbations below.
